name: @pletivo/workers
description: Pletivo's Cloudflare Worker host: compiles and renders a project inside a Worker Loader isolate. Ships TypeScript source for the host Worker to bundle.
//: No build step, by design — see the note in @pletivo/runtime. The host worker's bundler is the only thing that can embed astro.wasm and Tailwind's stylesheets, so this package ships source and is bundled by the app.

scripts.prepublishOnly: echo 'publish the staged tarball from scripts/package-pletivo.ts, not this directory' >&2 && exit 1
